abstract_sentences.text: We introduce the Latent Fourier Transform (LATENT FT), a framework that provides novel frequency-domain controls for generative music models.

evidence.anchor: We introduce the Latent Fourier Transform

abstract_sentences.text: LATENT FT combines a diffusion autoencoder with a latent-space Fourier transform to separate musical patterns by timescale.

evidence.anchor: combines a diffusion autoencoder with a latent-space Fourier transform

abstract_sentences.text: By masking latents in the frequency domain during training, our method yields representations that can be manipulated coherently at inference.

evidence.anchor: masking latents in the frequency domain during training

abstract_sentences.text: This allows us to generate musical variations and blends from reference examples while preserving characteristics at desired timescales, which are specified as frequencies in the latent space.

evidence.anchor: generate musical variations and blends from reference examples

abstract_sentences.text: LATENT FT parallels the role of the equalizer in music production: while traditional equalizers operates on audible frequencies to shape timbre, LATENT FT operates on latent-space frequencies to shape musical structure.

evidence.anchor: operates on latent-space frequencies to shape musical structure

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments and listening tests show that LATENT FT improves condition adherence and quality compared to baselines.

evidence.anchor: improves condition adherence and quality compared to baselines

abstract_sentences.text: We also present a technique for hearing frequencies in the latent space in isolation, and show different musical attributes reside in different regions of the latent spectrum.

evidence.anchor: hearing frequencies in the latent space in isolation

abstract_sentences.text: Our results show how frequency-domain control in latent space provides an intuitive, continuous frequency axis for conditioning and blending, advancing us toward more interpretable and interactive generative music models.

evidence.anchor: intuitive, continuous frequency axis for conditioning and blending

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 reference music 中难以精确指定的 arbitrary timescale 转化为 latent sequence 的 Fourier frequency axis；训练时用同类随机 spectral masks 让 diffusion decoder 从缺失频带恢复，推理时用用户 mask 完成 variation、blending、isolation 和 attribute sweep（pp. 1–7）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 DFT 正交性、5 个编号公式、latent mask 机制、三段算法、主 Table 1 及 Fig. 3–5，承担从方法到任务决策的最短闭环（pp. 4–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: encoder/decoder 结构、训练与 mask 超参数、数据集、band 划分、听测检验、isolation 实现、额外数据集、消融和 DFT 推导移入 Appendix A–D；复现与不利解释依赖这些页面（pp. 18–31）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: “频率轴定义 → mask 训练 → 选频条件生成/混合 → descriptor 与 spectrogram 双证据 → sweep 解释”保持方法、结果和解释同轴；Table 1 对齐四类 descriptor 与 FAD（pp. 5–10）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有 formal disentanglement theorem、频率独立性指标或完整不确定性报告；作者写作限定为 to some extent，听测 kappa 也只有 slight agreement，且没有独立 limitations 章节（pp. 9–10、17、22）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 主张可操作 latent axis 时，训练阶段应暴露与推理一致的结构化 mask，并为每个控制任务配对任务相关 descriptor、整体质量量化和可试听/可视化证据（pp. 6、8–10、24–26）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则依赖 linear temporal latent sequence、DFT 可逆性、diffusion decoder 和短音乐片段；本文未覆盖实时交互、语义 disentanglement、长序列或更广音频域（pp. 5–7、10、18–21）。

method_formula_summary.numbered_formulas: 5: Eq. (1) real sinusoid; Eq. (2) encoder; Eq. (3) latent DFT; Eq. (4) correlated log-frequency kernel; Eq. (5) decoder estimate.
method_formula_summary.named_formulas: DFT and IDFT are unnumbered displays on p. 4.
method_formula_summary.theory_role: DFT orthogonality is an inductive bias/explanatory mechanism; no formal theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, or proof.
method_formula_summary.latent_frequency_mapping: f_k = k f_r / T_prime Hz; zero-padding gives F = floor(L T_prime / 2) + 1 bins.
method_formula_summary.mask_distribution: eta ~ N(0,1), s ~ N(0_F, Sigma), M = 1_{s>eta}; s = K u and Sigma = K K^T.

statistical_summary.main_aggregation: 1024 clips and 14 bands for conditional generation; blending averages adherence to two selected subbands.
statistical_summary.listening_tests: Kruskal–Wallis H p = 6.4 × 10^-83; post-hoc Wilcoxon signed-rank with Bonferroni p < 0.05/6.
statistical_summary.pairwise_outcomes: Audio quality: all pairs significant except Cross Synthesis vs ILVR. Ability to blend: all pairs significant except LATENT FT vs Cross Synthesis.
statistical_summary.inter_rater: Fleiss kappa = 0.0654 and 0.0914, both reported as slight agreement.
statistical_summary.uncertainty: No confidence intervals, effect sizes, or seed-level dispersion for main metric tables.
